findings.summary: The export expands lots into one row per conversion document without enforcing EXCEL_MAX_ROWS. The supplied exact projection is 1,807,231 rows, exceeding Excel's 1,048,576-row worksheet limit, so the required ordinary single-sheet workbook cannot remain valid/downloadable for the default annual data.

Nested flatMap/map eagerly materializes the entire 1,807,231-row array in browser memory before workbook generation, with each row retaining lot, order, and conversion objects. This is unbounded and can exhaust browser memory or make generation fail.
EXCEL_MAX_ROWS is declared but never used, so there is no capacity check, bounded-output strategy, or explicit error path before writeSingleBrowserWorksheet is called.

unverified: The supplied diff contains no tests demonstrating behavior at, below, or above the Excel worksheet row limit.

The behavior of writeSingleBrowserWorksheet when given more than 1,048,576 rows, including whether it rejects, truncates, corrupts, or still produces a downloadable artifact, cannot be verified from the supplied text.
Header-row accounting and any other worksheet rows added by writeSingleBrowserWorksheet are not shown; usable data-row capacity may be lower than 1,048,576.

findings.summary: displayedClosing omits the supported fx_other consumption category, so the displayed closing balance is overstated by 1,494,440 TRY for the observed case and cannot reconcile exactly.

unverified: Opening, inflow, and totals for expense and fx_eur are not supplied, so their numerical reconciliation cannot be independently verified.

No tests, type definitions, sum implementation, numeric representation, or display/formatting code are shown, so compilation, numerical stability, and exact presentation of every turnover component cannot be verified.

findings.summary: Rounding every detail independently does not preserve the rounded source total; the supplied evidence reports 1578 TRY of aggregate drift. Allocate in integer minor units and distribute the residual cents deterministically (for example, by largest remainder) so detail amounts reconcile exactly.

unverified: Behavior for shares that do not sum to 1, negative or non-finite inputs, currencies whose minor-unit precision differs from two decimals, and tie-breaking for residual distribution is not specified or testable from the supplied diff.
No tests are shown for exact per-source reconciliation, rounding boundaries, large values, or an average 5.8-row split workload.

findings.summary: The verify script no longer runs `prisma generate` before TypeScript checking, so schema changes such as `newcrmChangedSince` can be checked against stale generated clients, directly violating the required release-gate ordering.

Appending `|| echo existing Prisma mismatch` converts every non-zero `tsc --noEmit` result into a successful script exit, masking all type errors and violating the requirement that any typecheck failure remain non-zero.
A temporary reviewer-only debug probe is added to the release tree, directly violating the requirement to ship only product and durable public methodology artifacts.
Private scratch notes from the review run are added to the release tree, directly violating the frozen acceptance criteria.
